text: Ukrainian troops successfully recaptured the strategic eastern city of Lyman from Russian forces on October 1, 2022.
The Constitutional Court of Russia formally declared the annexation of Southern and Eastern Ukraine as constitutional on October 2, 2022 in Moscow.
Ramzan Kadyrov called on the Russian government to introduce martial law and use nuclear weapons in Ukraine after the defeat in Lyman on October 2, 2022.
The European Union sanctioned Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps in response to the repression of the Mahsa Amini protests on October 3, 2022 in Brussels.
Canada permanently banned 10,000 IRGC members from entering the country on October 7, 2022 in Ottawa.
Belarusian activist Ales Bialiatski was awarded the Nobel Peace Prize on October 7, 2022 in Oslo, Norway.
Russia launched eight missiles at Mykolaiv on October 8, 2022, hitting a residential building and killing civilians including an 11-year-old boy.
Vladimir Putin ordered retaliatory missile strikes on Kyiv and other Ukrainian cities on October 10, 2022 from Moscow.
The United Nations General Assembly voted to condemn Russia's annexation of four Ukrainian regions on October 12, 2022 in New York.
Saudi Arabia denied responsibility for oil production cuts to the United States on October 13, 2022.
Kwasi Kwarteng was dismissed by Prime Minister Liz Truss as Chancellor of the Exchequer on October 14, 2022 in London.
Iranian police used force against mourners in Saqqez to mark the 40-day mourning period for Mahsa Amini on October 26, 2022.
Israel and Lebanon signed a historic maritime border agreement brokered by the United States on October 27, 2022.
The United States provided additional military aid worth $275 million to Ukraine on October 28, 2022 in Washington.
Russian Defence Minister Sergei Shoigu declared the completion of military mobilization on October 28, 2022 in Moscow.
Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva won Brazil's presidential election by defeating Jair Bolsonaro on October 30, 2022 in Brasilia.
Xi Jinping was elected as General Secretary of the Chinese Communist Party for an unprecedented third term on October 23, 2022 in Beijing.
Rishi Sunak became the Prime Minister of the United Kingdom on October 25, 2022 in London, becoming the first British Asian to hold the office.
Russia vetoed a United Nations Security Council resolution declaring its Ukraine annexation illegal on October 22, 2022 in New York.
North Korea fired two short-range ballistic missiles into the East Sea on October 6, 2022 from Pyongyang.
Turkey's President Erdogan met with Russian President Putin in Astana, Kazakhstan on October 13, 2022 to discuss the grain deal.
South Korea and the United States conducted joint air drills involving B-1B bombers on October 19, 2022 over the Korean Peninsula.
Venezuela released seven Americans including five Citgo executives in a prisoner exchange with the United States on October 1, 2022.
Germany announced a 200 billion euro energy relief package to shield consumers from rising costs on October 4, 2022 in Berlin.
China condemned Nancy Pelosi's visit to Taiwan and launched military exercises around the island in August 2022.
Japan imposed additional sanctions on Russia over the invasion of Ukraine on October 7, 2022 in Tokyo.
The International Monetary Fund approved a bailout package for Pakistan to prevent economic collapse in August 2022 in Washington.
India abstained from voting on the UN resolution condemning Russia's annexation of Ukrainian territories on October 12, 2022 in New York.
France provided military equipment including Caesar howitzers to Ukraine on October 15, 2022.
Australia announced new sanctions against Russia targeting luxury goods and gold on October 14, 2022 in Canberra.
Volodymyr Zelensky addressed the European Council via video link requesting additional military support on October 20, 2022 from Kyiv.
Iran sent military drones to Russia for use in the Ukraine conflict according to reports on October 18, 2022.
NATO Secretary General Jens Stoltenberg warned Russia of the dangers of nuclear escalation on October 12, 2022 in Brussels.
Egypt hosted a climate summit COP27 in Sharm el-Sheikh beginning on November 6, 2022.
Mexico's President Lopez Obrador proposed a peace plan for the Russia-Ukraine conflict on October 5, 2022 in Mexico City.
The United Kingdom expelled the Russian defense attache from London following espionage allegations on October 10, 2022.
Pakistan's former Prime Minister Imran Khan was shot during a protest march in Wazirabad on November 3, 2022.
South Africa's President Ramaphosa met with Putin at the BRICS summit on October 18, 2022 in Moscow.
Finland and Sweden formally applied to join NATO after Russia's invasion of Ukraine on May 18, 2022 in Brussels.
The European Central Bank raised interest rates by 75 basis points to combat inflation on October 27, 2022 in Frankfurt.
Poland requested deployment of German Patriot missiles on its territory after a stray missile killed two people on November 15, 2022.
Brazil's newly elected President Lula da Silva pledged to end deforestation in the Amazon during COP27 on November 16, 2022 in Sharm el-Sheikh.
Indonesia hosted the G20 summit in Bali on November 15, 2022 where leaders discussed the global food and energy crisis.
Elon Musk completed his acquisition of Twitter for $44 billion on October 27, 2022 in San Francisco.
The United States Treasury Department imposed new sanctions on Iranian officials involved in cracking down on protesters on October 6, 2022.
China's foreign ministry criticized the United States for selling weapons to Taiwan on October 8, 2022 in Beijing.
Germany delivered the first IRIS-T air defense system to Ukraine on October 11, 2022.
Ethiopia's government and Tigray rebels agreed to a cessation of hostilities in Pretoria, South Africa on November 2, 2022.
The Philippines protested against China's aggressive actions in the South China Sea on October 24, 2022 in Manila.
Joe Biden signed the CHIPS Act to boost domestic semiconductor manufacturing on August 9, 2022 in Washington.
The United States and Japan agreed to strengthen their military alliance during a summit in Tokyo on January 13, 2023.
Germany arrested a suspected Russian spy working in its intelligence service on December 22, 2022 in Berlin.
The African Union suspended Niger following the military coup against President Bazoum on July 28, 2023.
India launched its Chandrayaan-3 spacecraft to the Moon on July 14, 2023 from Sriharikota.
Argentina's Javier Milei won the presidential election defeating Sergio Massa on November 19, 2023 in Buenos Aires.
NATO formally admitted Finland as its 31st member on April 4, 2023 in Brussels.
Wagner Group leader Yevgeny Prigozhin launched a brief armed rebellion against Russian military leadership on June 24, 2023.
South Korea imposed unilateral sanctions on North Korea over its nuclear weapons program on February 10, 2023 in Seoul.
The International Criminal Court issued an arrest warrant for Vladimir Putin on March 17, 2023 in The Hague.
China brokered a diplomatic agreement between Saudi Arabia and Iran to restore relations on March 10, 2023 in Beijing.
Ukraine received its first batch of Leopard 2 tanks from Germany on March 27, 2023.
Israel conducted a military raid on a Palestinian refugee camp in Jenin on July 3, 2023.
The European Parliament approved the AI Act, the world's first comprehensive AI regulation, on June 14, 2023 in Strasbourg.
Turkey approved Sweden's NATO membership bid after months of negotiations on January 23, 2024 in Ankara.
North Korea declared South Korea a hostile state and abolished reunification agencies on January 15, 2024 in Pyongyang.
Bangladesh Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina resigned and fled the country amid mass protests on August 5, 2024.
Russia and China conducted joint naval exercises in the Sea of Japan on July 20, 2023.
The United Kingdom signed a free trade agreement with Australia on December 16, 2022 in London.
France deployed additional troops to Niger before being expelled by the military junta on September 10, 2023.
SpaceX successfully launched the Starship rocket on its third test flight on March 14, 2024 from Boca Chica, Texas.
The World Health Organization declared the end of the COVID-19 global health emergency on May 5, 2023 in Geneva.
Iran executed prominent protest leader Mohsen Shekari on December 8, 2022 in Tehran.
Mexico nationalized its lithium reserves through a decree signed by President Lopez Obrador on February 22, 2023 in Mexico City.
Saudi Arabia and Russia agreed to extend oil production cuts through the end of 2023 on June 4, 2023.
Colombia signed a ceasefire agreement with the ELN rebel group on June 9, 2023 in Havana, Cuba.
The Philippines filed a diplomatic protest against China over a water cannon attack on its vessels in the South China Sea on August 6, 2023.
Singapore executed a man for trafficking two pounds of cannabis on April 26, 2023 despite international outcry.
Italy blocked ChatGPT over privacy concerns becoming the first Western country to ban the AI chatbot on March 31, 2023 in Rome.
Morocco defeated Portugal 1-0 to become the first African team to reach the World Cup semi-finals on December 10, 2022 in Doha.
Nvidia surpassed Apple to become the world's most valuable company with a market cap of $3.5 trillion on June 18, 2024.
The Swiss government froze $8 billion in Russian assets as part of international sanctions on January 20, 2023 in Bern.
Sudan's military clashed with the Rapid Support Forces in Khartoum on April 15, 2023, starting a civil war.
New Zealand elected Christopher Luxon as Prime Minister after the National Party won elections on October 14, 2023 in Wellington.
Google laid off 12,000 employees as part of a major restructuring on January 20, 2023 announced from Mountain View.
Canada expelled a Chinese diplomat accused of targeting a Canadian member of parliament on May 8, 2023 in Ottawa.
Thailand elected Srettha Thavisin as Prime Minister ending months of political deadlock on August 22, 2023 in Bangkok.
The United Nations warned of a humanitarian catastrophe in Gaza following the Israeli military offensive on October 13, 2023.
Norway announced a $1 billion aid package for Ukraine at a donors conference in Paris on December 13, 2022.
Vietnam arrested a prominent climate activist on charges of tax evasion on September 15, 2023 in Hanoi.
Tesla CEO Elon Musk met with Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu to discuss AI and technology cooperation on September 18, 2023.
Ecuador declared a state of internal armed conflict after gang violence erupted across the country on January 9, 2024 in Quito.
Taiwan's William Lai won the presidential election defeating KMT candidate Hou Yu-ih on January 13, 2024 in Taipei.
The European Union imposed a price cap on Russian crude oil at $60 per barrel on December 5, 2022 in Brussels.
Kenya deployed troops to eastern Congo as part of an East African peacekeeping force on November 12, 2022.
Alphabet CEO Sundar Pichai announced the launch of Google's AI model Gemini on December 6, 2023 in Mountain View.
Peru declared a state of emergency in Lima after mass protests against President Boluarte on January 15, 2023.
The United States shot down a Chinese surveillance balloon over the Atlantic Ocean on February 4, 2023.
South Africa hosted the BRICS summit where the bloc invited six new members on August 24, 2023 in Johannesburg.
Myanmar's military junta extended the state of emergency for another six months on February 1, 2023 in Naypyidaw.
Denmark agreed to supply F-16 fighter jets to Ukraine on August 20, 2023 at a summit in The Hague.
